verification.scope: the reference of the given model: its analysis results (with the design results where the change is one of design data only) or, if it is unstable, its mechanism diagnosis
verification.meaning: 'verified' means only: the reference solution passed every tier listed as applicable in this record, at the tolerances stated in it. It does not mean reviewed, approved or certified by anyone.
verification.policy: docs/VERIFICATION.md; the tiers passed and the tolerances are in the answers file and in the info returned when the episode ends
